QUOTE: "a new string is added by defining the error macro and regenerating the table, not by hand-editing `error.c`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gets the header define, regeneration and no hand-edit of `error.c`. It never says the string comes from the `/** */` doc comment on the `#define`. Step 2 instead has the user add the description to separate generator "data files", which is a different mechanism.
